cases.pseudocode: u64 check_account(Account *account, Pubkey *expected_owner) { if (account->is_signer == 0) return 7; if (memcmp(account->owner, expected_owner, 32) != 0) return 8; return 0; }
u64 process(u8 *data, u64 len) { if (len < 1) return 1; switch (data[0]) { case 0: return transfer_checked_cpi(data + 1); case 1: return close_account_cpi(); default: return 2; } }

u64 update(u64 *balance, u64 amount, u8 *buffer, u64 index, u64 size) { if (index >= size) return 3; u64 old = *balance; u64 next = old + amount; if (next < old) return 4; buffer[index] = 1; *balance = next; return 0; }
void clear(u8 *dst, u64 n) { u64 i = 0; LAB_1: if (i >= n) goto LAB_2; *(dst + i) = 0; i = i + 1; goto LAB_1; LAB_2: return; }
